name: Rating Boost

tenures.source: Listed as a stable on the fed's concept page and its roster page: 'Cleveland Paige, C.D. Justice, & Stevie Nash (Rating Boost)'; the sheets for Paige and Nash say they are allied as Rating Boost.

caption: The heel trio of Cleveland Paige, C.D. Justice and Stevie Nash, two of them once rivals in Ohio; Justice was a late replacement for a third member who backed out.

identity.note: No other unit of this name is on file; recorded as its own record pending any future collision.

name: Southern Baptist Coalition

tenures.source: Listed on the fed's concept page as 'Deacon & Abraham w/Jimmy Davis (Southern Baptist Coalition)'; the sheets for Deacon, Abraham and Jimmy Davis say the two were jobbers renamed by Davis, who manages them.

caption: The heel tag team of Deacon and Abraham, once jobbers, renamed and managed by Jimmy Davis; the fed's third tag team.

identity.note: NFW's Southern Baptist Coalition debuted on 5 August 2007 as Abraham and Jacobs, managed by Jimmy Davis; this fed's is Deacon and Abraham with Jimmy Davis. Same name, the same manager and one shared member (both drafted presumed-same with NFW's records); the second member differs, and NFW's long-running Deacon is not this fed's Deacon, whose sheet calls Memphis PRO his first promotion.

name: The Turks

tenures.source: Listed on the fed's concept page as 'Laguna & Reno (the Turks)'; the sheets say they are brothers and the leading face tag team.

caption: The face tag team of the brothers Laguna and Reno.

identity.note: No other unit of this name is on file; recorded as its own record pending any future collision.
